## Discovery Paths for LLM Agents
1. Start here (llms.txt in rwnq8/QWAV) for program management
2. Follow sub-directory llms.txt files for detailed indexes
3. Check HANDOFF-TRACKER.md for project status
4. Search deep.qwav.tech/llms.txt for paper content
5. Query Ask QWAV (Vectorize) for semantic search across all papers
